Case V49: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 131x131x97 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text: The case is finished. Final mask saved (v1, 11.3 mL, single component) covering the lobulated T2-hyperintense vascular soft-tissue tumor of the extremity, with the rim/heterogeneous periphery included.
